info.text:
# Northgard

Northgard can be played in two modes, picked with the `game_mode` option in your YAML:
**Conquest**, the campaign map, or **Bifrost**, the roguelite.

## What does randomization do to this game?

### Conquest

Northgard's Conquest mode always unlocks its battles in the same fixed branching tree
(Chapter 01 leads to a Top/Bottom pair, each of those leads to another pair or a single
battle, and so on up to Chapter 07). Normally you unlock the next battle just by winning
the current one. In this randomizer, unlocking a Chapter instead requires receiving that
Chapter's item from the multiworld. It may be found in your own world or someone else's.

"Chapter" is this randomizer's own name for each position in that tree. It isn't
Northgard's own terminology, so here's what it actually maps to on your Conquest map:

![The Conquest map with each Chapter position labeled Chapter 1 through Chapter 7](images/chapters.png)

Two Progression Modes control exactly how that gate works:
- **Linear**: same as vanilla Conquest's own flow. A Chapter also needs an adjacent Chapter
  beaten first, on top of owning its item.
- **Non-Linear**: a Chapter unlocks the moment you receive its item, letting you jump
  around the tree out of order. A separate option can require a number of other battles
  be won first before Chapter 07 specifically unlocks, so it can't be rushed immediately.

### Bifrost

Each realm is unlocked by an item. Midgard is always open; Muspelheim, Niflheim, Nidavellir,
Idavoll and Vanaheim each need the item named after them. In the lobby, a realm you don't have
yet shows as a greyed-out card you can't pick, and it lights up as soon as its item arrives.
Realms you can play that still hold a progression item are offered first. Vanaheim is still
only offered as the last step of a run.

Your progress carries over between runs, won or lost, so expect to play many runs.

## What is the goal?

- **Conquest:** win Chapter 07, the final battle of the Conquest tree.
- **Bifrost:** complete Vanaheim, the final realm.

## What items and locations get shuffled?

### Conquest

Each of the 11 Chapter positions has one unlock item. Each Chapter also has up to 10
locations ("Chapter N - Item 01" .. "Item 10"), sent together the moment you win that
Chapter's battle. The exact count per Chapter is set by the "Items per Chapter" option.

### Bifrost

Locations:
- Completing each realm (Vanaheim is the goal, not a location).
- Every objective a realm can have: its portals, the Wyvern, the Nidavellir Beacon, the
  Pillar of God and the Befriend objectives. Maps favour objectives holding a progression
  item first, then the ones you haven't done yet.
- Some of the cards on perk screens (after a wave or an objective). These show the
  Archipelago logo, and hovering one shows which item it holds. Picking it sends that item
  instead of giving the perk; on later visits that card is a normal perk again. The "AP Perk
  Cards" option sets how many cards are Archipelago cards. Portal rewards always have one.
  Objective rewards never offer a perk someone in your group already has.

Items:
- The 5 realms.
- Bonus items: Military, Economy, Special, Clan and Objective Bonus, one bonus per realm (for
  example "Muspelheim Bonus"), and Building Unlock. At the start of every run each one becomes a
  random perk or building that fits your clan and that you don't have yet. They show in the
  game's Bonuses tab and last the whole run.

### Both modes

The rest of the pool is 7 resources (Krowns, Food, Wood, Lore/Faith, Stone, Iron, Military
Experience/Hunting Trophies), each as two kinds of item: a filler item (e.g. "100 Food")
grants that amount instantly while you're actively playing, but is lost if you're not
online to receive it; a "Starting" item (e.g. "50 Starting Food") is a one-time permanent
bonus applied at the start of every battle you play from then on, so it's never lost to
being offline.

## What does another world's item look like in Northgard?

There's no special in-game notification. The companion client applies a received item
quietly in the background (you'll see it in the client's own log), and the effect shows up
directly in-game: the Conquest map, the Bifrost realm cards or Bonuses tab, or your resource
totals the next time a battle is running.

## Multiplayer

Both modes can be played in co-op. Every player joins the same slot and runs their own
Northgard Client. In Bifrost, every player gets their own copy of each bonus item.

tutorials.text:
# Northgard Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- Northgard (Steam)
- The `northgard.apworld` file, installed like any other apworld

## Installation

1. Place `northgard.apworld` in your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds` folder. Every
   player with a Northgard slot (single player or multiplayer) needs to do this on their own
   machine, even if someone else is generating/hosting the room.
2. Add a Northgard entry to your player YAML. See `Northgard.yaml` for a ready-to-use
   template, and set `game_mode` to `conquest` or `bifrost`.
3. Generate or join a multiworld using your Northgard YAML.
4. Open the Archipelago Launcher and click **Northgard Client**.
5. Connect it to your room the same way you would any other Archipelago client.
6. First time on a given computer, it might ask where your Northgard save folder is (usually
   found automatically); use `/savedir` any time to check or change it.
7. Leave the client running in the background while you play. You don't need to report
   anything in-game.

### Conquest

8. Launch Northgard. If you don't already have a Conquest save for this playthrough,
   start a new one now. Every Chapter will show as locked until you pin the save in the
   next step.
9. Run `/conquest` in the client to see your in-progress Conquest saves and pick the one
   for this playthrough with e.g. `/conquest 1`. This is remembered per slot in each
   Archipelago room, so playing more than one Northgard slot (in the same seed or in
   different rooms) doesn't mix up which save belongs to which. Any items you've already
   received unlock within a few seconds of pinning, live in-game, with no need to back out
   of the map screen or relaunch anything.

### Bifrost

8. Launch Northgard and start a Bifrost run, or continue one. There's no save to pick.
9. Use `/bifrost` in the client any time to see which realms are unlocked and how many
   locations each one still has.

## Multiplayer

Every player joins the same slot, installs the apworld and runs their own Northgard Client
connected to the room. Then start the Northgard co-op game together as usual.

## Uninstalling

- To play vanilla Northgard again, just double-click the standalone `patch_northgard.exe`.
  It finds your Northgard install automatically and gives you a menu to check status or
  restore to vanilla.

readme.text:
# Archipelago-Northgard

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) randomizer for **Northgard**, played in **Conquest
mode** or the roguelite **Bifrost mode**.
Complete your Conquest map by winning Chapter 7, or conquer Vanaheim across as many Bifrost
runs as it takes, solo or in co-op.

* See [how randomization works](worlds/northgard/docs/en_Northgard.md) (both modes: goal,
what gets shuffled)
* Follow the [setup guide](worlds/northgard/docs/setup_en.md) (full
install/connect walkthrough, including uninstall) for details.

---

### Questions or feedback?

Need help, found a bug, or have an idea? Join my Discord server, [Chakraa's Projects](https://discord.gg/bkk4nVXcjm), and post in this project's channel.

notes.text:
### Fixed
- Reward screens can't get stuck in co-op anymore. Objective rewards used to offer perks someone in the group already had, which showed up grey and couldn't be picked. Now they only offer perks nobody has yet, and if one you already own still slips through, you can pick it and it just gives nothing.

### Changed
- Objectives holding a progression item now show up first on your maps, and realms holding one get offered first in the lobby. Should mean way fewer runs hunting for that one Wyvern.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.11.13...2026.11.13.2
